candidate_name: Pengerang LNG FSU augmentation (Puteri Delima Satu)
sponsor_or_proposer: Pengerang LNG (Two) Sdn Bhd / MISC Bhd
current_state: MISC converting LNG carrier Puteri Delima Satu into a floating storage unit (FSU) for the existing Pengerang Johor LNG Terminal under a 20-year contract, targeted commercially operational H1 2025. This is a storage-capacity augmentation at an EXISTING GEM terminal (T100000130291), not a new terminal. GEM's Pengerang record currently shows no FloatingVesselName and Floating is blank (terminal is onshore-tank-based with two 200,000 m3 tanks).
missing_threshold_elements: Not a new terminal - already in GEM. Question is whether to add the FSU as a vessel/storage detail on the existing Pengerang record; unclear if it changes nameplate regas capacity (3.5 mtpa) or is purely storage. No nameplate change confirmed.
watch_for: Confirmation that Puteri Delima Satu FSU is in service at Pengerang and whether it lifts the terminal's effective send-out capacity above 3.5 mtpa; if so, route to Update for the existing terminal (FloatingVesselName / VesselOwner MISC + any capacity change).
notes: Vessel owner = MISC (distinct from terminal owners PGB/Dialog/Permodalan Darul Takzim). FSU is storage-only, so the FSRU sync rule's FSU/FRU clause applies if added. Logged for the next batch rather than staged this batch (no confirmed nameplate or status change).
